inspiration: Paper-doll character: four stacked attachment layers (shadow, body, head, shield) with a fixed draw order. Worth recreating as our own layered sprite with a ground shadow under the body and a swappable off-hand layer. Reference: internal/character/attachments.go.

Eight facing directions in a fixed table, with a remap that lets a set of drawn facings cover all eight by mirroring. Recreate the remap idea with our own facing count (six, for example) rather than copying the order. Reference: internal/character/directiontype/statetype.go.

Action blocks: each action owns a block of eight direction rows in one atlas (idle, walk, attack and so on start at fixed offsets). Recreate as our own atlas layout with per-action frame counts. Reference: internal/character/actionindex/actionindex.go.

Palette-indexed sprites packed with run-length rows, which gives a crisp retro edge and small files. Recreate with our own 16-colour ramps per character class, not the donor's format. Reference: internal/fileformat/spr/spr_file.go.

Hard-edged sprite cut: fragments below alpha 0.1 are discarded, then the texture is multiplied by a per-vertex tint. Use the tint as a hit flash or faction colour, implemented as our own shader. Reference: internal/system/opengl/shaders/sprite.frag.

Sprite-pair data model: each action file is matched to its sprite sheet by name, so a character is a manifest of pairs rather than hard-coded art. Worth a similar manifest for our own asset packs. Reference: internal/fileformat/grf/grf_file.go.

briefs.label: Paper-doll hero
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Silhouette reads at 375 wide when the head layer and off-hand layer add two clear shapes. Signature behaviour: a one-frame hit flash by tint. Signature effect: a soft shadow layer under the body. Target 20-30 percent resemblance to the donor's layered idea.
keep: stacked layers with a ground shadow
change: a shoulder mantle as the top layer instead of a head layer

briefs.label: Eight-facing action atlas
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Signature behaviour: a direction-locked walk cycle, readable from the south view. Signature sound: none in the repo (not read). Target 20-30 percent resemblance to the donor's block layout.
keep: mirror remap so fewer drawn sets cover all facings
change: per-action frame counts instead of a fixed eight

briefs.label: Packed indexed sprite
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Crisp retro edges and small files. Signature effect: palette swap for variants. Target 20-30 percent resemblance to the donor's packed format idea.
